# `kernel/net/net` — the networking protocol stacks of the 4.5BSD kernel — net

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the networking protocol stacks of the 4.5BSD kernel — net.

`config.mk` records 12 source file(s) here: `bpf.c`, `bpf_filter.c`, `if.c`, `if_ethersubr.c`, `if_loop.c`, `if_sl.c`, `radix.c`, `raw_cb.c`, `raw_usrreq.c`, `route.c`, `rtsock.c`, `slcompress.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
